title: Worksheet 5: Firewalls (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: A firewall is a security system, either hardware, software, or a combination of both, that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on a set of security rules. A firewall acts like a security guard standing at the entrance of a building, deciding which visitors are allowed in and which are turned away, except instead of people, a firewall examines data traveling in and out of a network or device. When data attempts to enter or leave a network, the firewall checks it against its rules; if the data appears safe and matches allowed criteria, it is permitted through, but if it looks suspicious or matches a known threat, the firewall blocks it. Firewalls can be configured to block traffic from specific locations, allow only certain types of connections, or prevent unauthorized programs from accessing the internet. Most modern operating systems come with a built-in software firewall already enabled by default, while many businesses also use additional hardware firewalls to protect their entire network.
